WHAT: cargo-xwin enables full macOS→Windows Rust cross-compilation including C/C++ dependencies
HOW:
  brew install llvm ninja
  cargo install cargo-xwin
  cargo xwin check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
GOTCHA:
  - whisper-rs `metal` feature must be macOS-only in Cargo.toml (platform-specific dep)
  - mach2 must be macOS-only dep
  - build.rs must use CARGO_CFG_TARGET_OS env var (runtime), not #[cfg(target_os)] (host)
  - Vulkan SDK missing on macOS = expected build failure at C layer only, Rust compiles fine
  - ring crate needs llvm-lib; opusic-sys needs ninja — both now installed
WHY: cargo-xwin downloads Windows SDK headers and CRT automatically, enabling C code to cross-compile
WORKFLOW: Write code on macOS, `cargo xwin check` to validate, push, build natively on Windows (UTM/CI) for actual .exe
